subject: maths
question: An article is sold at three successive discounts of 10%, 20% and 25%. If the selling price of the article is Rs. 2,592, then what is the marked price of the article?
solution:
**Given:**

Discounts = 10%, 20% & 25%

Selling price = SP = Rs. 2,592

**Formula used:**

Selling price = (1 - D1 / 100) x (1 - D2 / 100) x (1 - D3 / 100) x MP

MP = Marked price

**Solution:**

2592 = (1 - 0.1) x (1 - 0.2) x (1 - 0.25) x MP

2592 = 0.9 x 0.8 x 0.75 x MP

2592 = 0.54 x MP

MP = 2592/0.54 = 4800

**Hence, the marked price is Rs. 4,800.**
